# get_energies_for_group { #mofography.compute.get_energies_for_group }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-legacy">legacy</span> Older LJ voxel sampling for energy-based pocket typing; env_cluster is default now. Use `add_env_cluster_pocket_types_to_rag` instead.

```python
compute.get_energies_for_group(
    group,
    props,
    ase_atoms,
    shape,
    forcefield_mixed=None,
    cutoff=12.5,
    return_coords=False,
    block_size=20000,
    sample_fraction=1,
)
```

Sample Lennard-Jones energies at voxels in a PBC pocket group (legacy energy-based pocket typing).
